title: Change Snooze Intervals
symptom: The user wants to change the snooze interval values (e.g., remove 20 minutes and change 40 and 50 minutes to 45). They found that pressing and holding on a value turns it into a text field, but changing the value does not affect the result (e.g., 20 remains 20).
evidence_quote: Changing doesn't affect on result (20 lefts 20).
